metadata.name: obs_publisher_did
metadata.description: IVOA dataset identifier for the published data set. It must be unique within the namespace controlled by the publisher.

metadata.name: obs_collection
metadata.description: The name of the data collection the data set belongs to.

metadata.name: obs_id
metadata.description: In case multiple data sets are available for an observation, e.g. with different calibration levels, the obs_id value will be the same for each data set the observation comprises. The obs_id should remain identical through time for future reference.

metadata.name: target_name
metadata.description: The target name as assigned by the Principal Investigator; ref. Ref. OBJECT keyword in ESO SDP standard. For spectroscopic public surveys, the value shall be set to the survey source identifier, which shall be unique within the survey

metadata.name: instrument_name
metadata.description: Name of the instrument(s) utilised to gather the data; if the data set combines multiple instruments, usually the value MULTI is assigned.

metadata.name: dataproduct_type
metadata.description: Logical data set type (image, spectrum, visibility, cube, measurements, etc.)

metadata.name: calib_level
metadata.description: Calibration level: 0-instrument (raw) data in non-standard format, 1-instrumental (raw) data in standard format, 2-science ready data with instrument signature removed, 3-more highly processed data. Ref. PRODLVL keyword in ESO SDP standard if present, otherwise: set to 3 when dataproduct_type contains token deep or tile, set to 4 for catalogs.

metadata.name: t_min
metadata.description: Start time in MJD; ref MJD-OBS keyword in ESO SDP standard.

metadata.name: t_max
metadata.description: Stop time in MJD; ref. MJD-END keyword in ESO SDP standard.

metadata.name: access_url
metadata.description: A URL that points to the DataLink (VO Standard) service that is used to download the dataset, associated files, their provenance or derived products, etc.

metadata.name: access_estsize
metadata.description: Estimated size of the downloaded file in KBytes.
